data.one_liner: Generates image thumbnails from local video files or URLs on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Generates image thumbnails from video files or URLs. It returns the image in memory as a Uint8List or saves it as a file with customizable format, resolution, and quality.
use_when: You need to display video thumbnails in a Flutter app from local files or URLs.
You want to save a generated video frame as an image file on the device.
avoid_when: You need web or desktop platform support (currently only supports Android and iOS).
You require complex video editing or full video playback capabilities.
strengths: Supports both in-memory thumbnails and saving directly to a file.
Customizable format (JPEG, PNG, WEBP), resolution, quality, and time offset.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Known minor performance issues when generating WebP thumbnails on iOS using libwebp.
data.setup_notes: Add video_thumbnail to pubspec.yaml. No extra native permissions documented in the README.
